title: Get a User’s Thread
knowledge:
# Get a User’s Thread ## Prerequisites - Must have permission to read Gmail threads/messages for the target user (thread access depends on the OAuth scope granted). ## Method `GET` ## URL `https://gmail.googleapis.com/gmail/v1/users/{{userId}}/threads/{{id}}` ## Headers ```json { "Accept": "application/json" } ``` ## Description Gets the specified Gmail thread (a conversation) for a user, returning a collection of messages and thread metadata. The message data returned can be controlled using the `format` query parameter. ## Enforcement Rules - The `userId` path parameter **must always be present**. - If the user provides a `userId`, use that value directly. - If the user does **not** provide a `userId`, default it explicitly to `"me"`. - Always construct the path as `/gmail/v1/users/{{userId}}/threads/{{id}}`, where `{{userId}}` is a **non-empty string**. - The `id` path parameter **must always be present** and must be a **non-empty string** (thread ID). - Do **not** call the API with a missing or empty `userId` or `id` (e.g., avoid `/users//threads/`). - Do **not** infer or guess `userId` beyond the user's input or the default `"me"`. - When executing the action, ensure to send **Path Parameters** in the URL and **not** in the body. - When executing the action, ensure to send **Query Parameters** in the URL as query parameters and **not** in the body. ### Valid Examples ```http /gmail/v1/users/me/threads/176c3b2f9a1b0abc /gmail/v1/users/user@example.com/threads/176c3b2f9a1b0abc ``` ### Invalid Examples ```http /gmail/v1/users//threads/176c3b2f9a1b0abc /gmail/v1/users/me/threads/ /gmail/v1/users/me/threads ``` ## Required Path Parameters | Parameter | Type | Description | |----------|--------|-------------| | `userId` | string | The user's email address. The special value `me` can be used to indicate the authenticated user. Default value: `me`. (Send in URL path) | | `id` | string | The ID of the thread to retrieve. (Send in URL path) | ## Optional Query Parameters | Parameter | Type | Description | |----------|------|-------------| | `format` | string | The format to return the messages in. Default: `full`. Possible values: `full`, `metadata`, `minimal`. (Send in URL query string)

Enum descriptions:
- `full`: Returns the full email message data with body content parsed in the `payload` field; the `raw` field is not used. Format cannot be used when accessing the api using the `gmail.metadata` scope.
- `metadata`: Returns only email message IDs, labels, and email headers.
- `minimal`: Returns only email message IDs and labels; does not return the email headers, body, or payload. | | `metadataHeaders` | string[] | When given and `format` is METADATA, only include headers specified. Repeated query parameter. (Send in URL query string) | ## Response ### Success Response (200 OK) ```json { "id": "176c3b2f9a1b0abc", "historyId": "9876543210", "snippet": "Thanks—let’s meet tomorrow at 10...", "messages": [ { "id": "18a7c1d2e3f4a5b6", "threadId": "176c3b2f9a1b0abc", "labelIds": ["INBOX", "IMPORTANT"], "snippet": "Thanks—let’s meet tomorrow at 10...", "historyId": "9876543211", "internalDate": "1710000000000", "sizeEstimate": 54321, "payload": { "partId": "", "mimeType": "multipart/alternative", "filename": "", "headers": [ { "name": "From", "value": "Alice " }, { "name": "To", "value": "Bob " }, { "name": "Subject", "value": "Meeting" }, { "name": "Date", "value": "Mon, 10 Mar 2025 10:00:00 +0000" } ], "body": { "size": 0, "data": "" }, "parts": [ { "partId": "0", "mimeType": "text/plain", "filename": "", "headers": [], "body": { "size": 120, "data": "SGVsbG8sIHRoaXMgaXMgYSB0ZXh0IGJvZHkuLi4" } } ] }, "raw": "RnJvbTogQWxpY2UgPGFsaWNlQGV4YW1wbGUuY29tPg0KVG86IEJvYiA8Ym9iQGV4YW1wbGUuY29tPg0KU3ViamVjdDogTWVldGluZw0KDQpIZWxsby4uLg==", "classificationLabelValues": [ { "labelId": "label_123", "fields": [ { "fieldId": "field_abc", "selection": "choice_1" } ] } ] } ] } ``` ### Error Response (401 Unauthorized) ```json { "error": { "code": 401, "message": "Request is missing required authentication credential.", "status": "UNAUTHENTICATED" } } ``` ### Error Response (404 Not Found) ```json { "error": { "code": 404, "message": "Requested entity was not found.", "status": "NOT_FOUND" } } ``` ## Response Fields | Field | Type | Description | |------|------|-------------| | `id` | string | The unique ID of the thread. | | `historyId` | string | The ID of the last history record that modified this thread. Format: `uint64` (string-encoded). | | `snippet` | string | A short part of the message text. | | `messages` | array | The list of messages in the thread. | | `messages[].id` | string | The immutable ID of the message. | | `messages[].threadId` | string | The ID of the thread the message belongs to. | | `messages[].labelIds` | array | List of IDs of labels applied to this message. | | `messages[].snippet` | string | A short part of the message text. | | `messages[].payload` | object | A single MIME message part. | | `messages[].payload.partId` | string | The immutable ID of the message part. | | `messages[].payload.mimeType` | string | The MIME type of the message part. | | `messages[].payload.filename` | string | The filename of the attachment. Only present if this message part represents an attachment. | | `messages[].payload.headers` | array | List of headers on this message part (e.g., `To`, `From`, `Subject`). | | `messages[].payload.headers[].name` | string | The name of the header before the `:` separator (e.g., `To`). | | `messages[].payload.headers[].value` | string | The value of the header after the `:` separator (e.g., `someuser@example.com`). | | `messages[].payload.body` | object | The body of a single MIME message part. | | `messages[].payload.body.size` | integer | Number of bytes for the message part data (encoding notwithstanding). Format: `int32`. | | `messages[].payload.body.attachmentId` | string | If present, the ID of an external attachment retrievable via `messages.attachments.get`. | | `messages[].payload.body.data` | string | The body data as a base64url encoded string. May be empty for container parts or when sent as a separate attachment. Format: `byte`. | | `messages[].payload.parts` | array | Child MIME parts (applies to container MIME parts like `multipart/*`). | | `messages[].raw` | string | The entire email message in RFC 2822 format, base64url encoded. (Note: described as returned when `format=RAW` is supplied in other endpoints.) | | `messages[].classificationLabelValues` | array | Classification Label values on the message (Google Workspace accounts only). | | `messages[].classificationLabelValues[].labelId` | string | Required. Canonical or raw alphanumeric classification label ID. | | `messages[].classificationLabelValues[].fields` | array | Field values for the given classification label ID. | | `messages[].classificationLabelValues[].fields[].fieldId` | string | Required. Field ID for the Classification Label Value. | | `messages[].classificationLabelValues[].fields[].selection` | string | Selection choice ID for selection option; used when field type is `SELECTION`. | | `messages[].internalDate` | string | Internal message creation timestamp (epoch ms). Format: `int64` (string-encoded). | | `messages[].sizeEstimate` | integer | Estimated size in bytes of the message. Format: `int32`. | | `messages[].historyId` | string | The ID of the last history record that modified this message. Format: `uint64` (string-encoded). | ## Sample Request ```bash curl -i --location --request GET \ 'https://gmail.googleapis.com/gmail/v1/users/me/threads/176c3b2f9a1b0abc?format=full' \ --header 'Accept: application/json' ``` ## Example Usage ### Example 1: Get a Thread for the Authenticated User (Default `me`) ```bash curl -sS \ 'https://gmail.googleapis.com/gmail/v1/users/me/threads/176c3b2f9a1b0abc' \ -H 'Accept: application/json' ``` ### Example 2: Get a Thread Returning Only Minimal Message Data ```bash curl -sS \ 'https://gmail.googleapis.com/gmail/v1/users/me/threads/176c3b2f9a1b0abc?format=minimal' \ -H 'Accept: application/json' ``` ### Example 3: Get a Thread in Metadata Format and Restrict Returned Headers ```bash curl -sS \ 'https://gmail.googleapis.com/gmail/v1/users/me/threads/176c3b2f9a1b0abc?format=metadata&metadataHeaders=From&metadataHeaders=To&metadataHeaders=Subject' \ -H 'Accept: application/json' ``` ## Notes - `metadataHeaders` is only applicable when using `format=metadata` (documentation states: “When given and format is METADATA, only include headers specified.”). - For `format=full`, the response includes message `payload` content; `payload.body.data` values are base64url encoded when present. - Some MIME parts may have empty `body.data` and instead provide `body.attachmentId` to fetch content via a separate attachment endpoint. ## Gotchas - `format=full` cannot be used when accessing the API using the `gmail.metadata` scope (per the enum description). - Do not place `userId` or `id` in the request body (this is a `GET` request; parameters belong in the URL). ## Error Handling - **401 Unauthorized**: Missing/invalid authentication credentials. - **404 Not Found**: The thread ID does not exist or is not accessible to the authenticated user. - Other errors may be returned by the API but were not included in the provided scraped content.
